description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineer, Internal Platforms based in the United States. 

 We are looking for a talented AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and optimize next-generation AI-powered applications and intelligent agent systems. In this role, you will work with cutting-edge large language models, modern AI frameworks, and scalable backend technologies to build reliable, production-ready solutions. You will take ownership of AI agent development, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and intelligent workflow orchestration. Collaborating closely with engineering and product teams, you will transform emerging AI capabilities into practical features that deliver measurable value. This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys experimentation, solving complex technical challenges, and contributing to innovative AI solutions within a fast-paced, remote-first environment.

Accountabilities:
 
 You will lead the development and continuous improvement of AI-powered applications, combining advanced machine learning capabilities with robust software engineering practices to deliver scalable and reliable production systems.


 
 Design, develop, and enhance AI agent capabilities using modern large language models (LLMs).



 
 Build scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI.



 
 Develop and optimize prompt workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and AI agent orchestration systems.



 
 Integrate AI APIs and third-party services to create intelligent, responsive, and scalable applications.



 
 Experiment with emerging AI models, frameworks, tools, and technologies to identify opportunities for innovation.



 
 Evaluate model performance, reliability, accuracy, and output quality, implementing improvements where necessary.



 
 Collaborate with engineering and product teams to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered features.



 
 Deploy, monitor, maintain, and optimize AI systems within production environments.



 
 Improve the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of AI applications through continuous testing and refinement.



 
 Stay informed about advancements in generative AI, machine learning, and agent-based architectures, applying relevant innovations to ongoing projects.




 Requirements :

 The ideal candidate combines strong Python software engineering skills with practical experience building LLM-powered applications, a solid understanding of AI agent architectures, and the ability to deliver high-quality solutions independently.


 
 Strong professional software engineering experience with Python.



 
 Hands-on experience developing applications powered by large language models (LLMs).



 
 Experience integrating AI APIs and building intelligent, AI-driven applications.



 
 Familiarity with AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable technologies.



 
 Experience designing and developing backend APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.



 
 Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and deployment environments, preferably AWS, GCP, or Azure.



 
 Strong understanding of generative AI concepts, prompt engineering, and AI application development.



 
 Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.



 
 Strong communication and collaboration abilities, with experience working across engineering and product teams.



 
 Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and adapt to a fast-paced remote engineering environment.




 Additional qualifications that would be advantageous:


 
 Experience deploying production-ready AI agents or generative AI products.



 
 Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, prompt optimization, and model evaluation techniques.



 
 Experience designing multi-step AI workflows and sophisticated agent orchestration systems.



 
 Contributions to open-source AI projects or experience developing independent AI applications.



 
 Familiarity with monitoring, evaluating, and optimizing AI systems operating in production environments.



 
 Previous experience working within AI-first technology organizations.




 Benefits :


 
 Fully remote work arrangement.



 
 Full-time employment opportunity.



 
 Opportunity to work with cutting-edge large language models and emerging AI technologies.



 
 Hands-on involvement in developing and deploying innovative AI-powered applications.



 
 Opportunity to experiment with modern AI frameworks, agent architectures, and generative AI solutions.



 
 Collaborative environment involving engineering and product teams.



 
 Opportunities for continuous technical learning, experimentation, and professional development.



 
 Compensation to be confirmed based on the applicable engagement structure.



 
 Equal employment opportunities, with candidates evaluated based on their skills, experience, and professional qualifications.
